messages:
anna (support): FYI acme reported dashboard shows 0 traffic for EU when they select region=EU and model=redwood-3b and version=2026-02-10. They say metrics exist otherwise.

liam (eng-analytics): cc @alex can you repro? do we have query logs?

anna (support): Steps from customer:
1) Console -> Analytics -> Select Region: EU
2) Filter model: redwood-3b
3) Filter version: 2026-02-10
4) Time range: last 24h
Result: chart shows 'No data'
Link to screenshot: https://acme.screenshots/abc123

alex (frontend): looking at network trace — UI is sending filters as `models: ["redwood-3b@2026-02-10"]` (single string) instead of separate model/version fields.

liam (eng-analytics): aha. backend expects `model` and `version` params. when it sees `models` combined it falls back to default region scope and then query planner prunes EU buckets.

alex (frontend): repro locally, query payload currently:
```
POST /api/analytics/query
{
  "region": "EU",
  "models": ["redwood-3b@2026-02-10"],
  "range": "24h"
}
```

working payload (what backend expects):
```
{
  "region": "EU",
  "model": "redwood-3b",
  "version": "2026-02-10",
  "range": "24h"
}
```

raj (product): That explains why selecting model+version from the dropdown (which concatenates) breaks server-side filtering. Was this changed in the dropdown UX rollout last week?

alex (frontend): yes, dropdown was updated to show compact tokens. regression introduced in 2.14.0.

liam (eng-analytics): I can patch backend to accept `models` array as compatibility short-term, but prefer fix in frontend.

infra-bot: cache invalidation triggered for cache-key=analytics:eu:models:stack-xyz by anna (support)

anna (support): Customer is experiencing this now, escalated to P1. They need ETA.

raj (product): Plan: (1) quick backend accept `models` alias (patch) -> 1-2h QA, (2) frontend rollback or token expansion fix -> 1 day, (3) add e2e test for combined token -> PR opened.

alex (frontend): pushing hotfix branch now -> PR #4528

liam (eng-analytics): rolling backend patch to canary now.

infra-bot: deploy canary to analytics-service succeeded (deploy-789) :white_check_mark:

liam (eng-analytics): canary query seen returning EU buckets correctly now. waiting 15m for telemetry.

anna (support): I'll update ACME: thanks, ETA 2h for immediate fix, full UI fix tomorrow.

anna (support): ACME replied: 'Thanks, that works for now' :relieved:
